_note: Builds as plain data (docs/TRAINER_REPORT.md): stock builds and the authored trainers' builds. Your journey builds stay in canon/builds.json and are read from there. Every authored build is a proposal until approved; anime movesets are drafts from the show and are checked against the game's learnsets (flags, not rejections, per D-024). Fields: species, moves, nickname, gender, nature, ivs, evs, item, ability, ball, friendship, ribbons, level, source, generation, tier, status, notes. Stock builds are the archetype library (Part 2): each has a name, the role it is meant for, a source, a generation and a tier ('unrated' until a source rates it; nothing external is trusted without a source).
